qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant enterprise lock-in in industrial automation hardware (Simatic PLCs) and mission-critical software (Siemens EDA/Mentor, NX CAD/PLM, TIA Portal) generates high customer switching costs and >25% operating/tangible ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (LT Debt / NI > 4.0x, REJECT). Industrial automation and software titan fails Munger fortress balance sheet hurdle due to €42.3B debt (4.4x NI), captive finance company (Siemens Financial Services) debt, and short-cycle industrial automation destocking.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 net income of €9,620M vs LT debt of €42,342M (4.4x ratio, exceeding the 4.0x ceiling). EBIT/interest coverage of 7.6x is below fortress thresholds. While Digital Industries software achieves high returns, captive financing operations and complex conglomerate debt obligations require ongoing market refinancing.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
